Crab Apple Wall Art Print - Pastel Botanical Framed Picture

A botanical wall art print in a pastel style, composed as single stem, in duotone. Printed to order on heavyweight art paper and supplied framed and ready to hang.

Frame

Choose black, white or oak at checkout. The main photograph shows the black frame.

Details

  • Giclee-style print on heavyweight matte art paper
  • Wooden moulding, glazed front, hanging fixture fitted
  • Sizes: A4 (21 x 29.7 cm), A3 (29.7 x 42 cm), A2 (42 x 59.4 cm)
  • Printed and framed in the United Kingdom
  • Dispatched carefully packed in protective board

Please note

This is a printed reproduction of digitally created artwork. It is not a painting and it is not signed. Colours can vary slightly between screens and print.

Message us before ordering if you need a different size and we will do our best to help.
